geometry_edits.rationale: Swap the over-abstract taper sequence for a stepped mass that can express a capacity-bearing upper hierarchy without collapsing the dominant bar into a pyramid.
Push the stepping along the short axis so the section reads as an inhabited upper transform rather than a single peak.
Use a limited number of meaningful terraces to avoid code-minimum looking tier repetition.
Moderate the stepping so the silhouette stays continuous and the upper mass remains subordinate to the base and void.
Carry the same sectional logic through the second mutation to maintain continuity rather than producing a separate sculptural cap.
Reduce the upper-tier emphasis slightly so the form does not read as an arbitrary mountain.
Tighten the final silhouette while keeping the section legible as one continuous building body.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the generic bar-like dominant mass with a split-wing or articulated massing rule to introduce a real public threshold while preserving the dominant gesture.
Keep the dominant mass organized along the long axis so the building can open a clearer ground edge to the access side.
Introduce a meaningful separation to support a legible public void rather than a sealed mound.
Align the void with the program-access side so the ground response becomes a true public threshold instead of a decorative carve.
Increase the carved open space so it can read as usable public ground in plan and section.

rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant object in all views, so it has some gesture clarity, but the form is overly pyramidal/tiered and the public/ground response is weak relative to the neighborhood-living brief. The visible mass does not convincingly establish an active street threshold on the verified access edge; the void is small and semantically soft, closer to a sculpted indentation than a usable public court or entry seam. Across views the object is mostly coherent, but the steep, singular peak and tapering mass do not resolve into a calm upper mass over an active base. The program fit fails because the section behaves like an abstract stepped mound rather than a capacity-aware street building with legible public ground, entry, and mixed-use hierarchy. Reference resonance is moderate where the candidate echoes elongated, carved, and terraced massing, but it lacks the clearer void/public-ground logic of the similar references.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more pavilion/campus-like and more openly glazed than a neighborhood living mass; use as spatial principle only.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long horizontal mass with a carved central public void and a slightly folded/continuous roof response to site.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The reference is more campus/office than neighborhood living; avoid copying the multi-wing campus scale.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Interlocking wings, bridge connection, and a large central courtyard can organize mixed-use massing with legible hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Very small single-pavilion typology; useful only for threshold articulation, not overall massing.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Simple low-rise street-facing volume with a clear entry canopy/threshold and a compact public edge response.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual reference; its strong residential terrace language and large sloping roof are too typologically specific and more housing-like than this candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped section and courtyard logic can support housing massing and upper hierarchy.

warnings: Parcel containment appears acceptable, so the failure is semantic rather than boundary-based.
The verified access edge is not strongly activated; the response feels sealed/opposite to the requested public threshold.
The section reads as an arbitrary cascading landform rather than a program-bearing neighborhood building.
Do not preserve the steep pyramidal emphasis if revising; keep only the notion of a single dominant mass with a clearer base void.
